mapper.select: SELECT FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO addresses ( user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE addresses SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
